testcase.name: Scenario: Inspect and cancels the custom line color picker: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-model-browser-source/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:481:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect and cancels the custom line color picker ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And a nested sketch in the MCAD Software has Default line color ✔ And its geometry properties dialog is open ✔ When the user chooses Select from the Line Color list ✔ Then a color dialog opens with basic color swatches and custom color slots ✔ When the user chooses Define Custom Colors ✔ Then the dialog expands to show a color field, brightness control and color preview ✔ And it shows hue, saturation, luminance and red, green and blue fields ✔ And it offers Add to Custom Colors ✔ When the user cancels the color dialog ✔ Then the geometry properties dialog shows Default line color ✔ And Apply is disabled ✔ When the user cancels the geometry properties dialog ✔ Then the dialog closes without applying a color change
